old_problem: The source does not define whether CRC-read, mode5 CRC-write or both are required, nor assign correctable/deferred/EEPROM signatures to a command; implicit GPU/address mapping and recovery are also absent.
disposition_reason: ED-15 forbids PASS without an authoritative oracle and ED-16 requires Recovery. Executing both commands would add unapproved coverage and mutate EEPROM/RAS state; executing one could omit intended coverage. The read/write scope and their separate ACA/deferred/EEPROM expectations must be ruled explicitly.
decision_basis: Directly read all18 XLSX cells and history2576.
Preserved both literal commands, zero/post counters, full ACA/address rows, deferred evidence and16-page EEPROM mutation.
Did not combine or choose read/write, and did not treat generic success as a verdict.
No modprobe, injection, EEPROM mutation, reset or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: UMC CRC replay read/write scope-conflicted injection
test_case.purpose: After an authoritative scope decision, validate each approved CRC replay variant with its own target, ACA/counter/deferred/EEPROM oracle and recovery.
required_package: Ruling: CRC-read, mode5 CRC-write, or two separately tracked variants
Approved amdgpuras version/hash/license and implicit GPU mapping
EEPROM cleanup, quiet window and GPU/OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute while scope is unresolved. After ruling, create separately traceable execution(s): capture zero counters and EEPROM baseline, run only the approved literal read or write command once, collect complete ACA/address/counter/deferred/EEPROM evidence for that variant, prove quieting, recover and restore before any separately authorized second variant.
test_case.expected_result: For each approved variant, only its defined correctable/deferred and EEPROM effects occur at the mapped target, counters and ACA/address evidence match, replay quiets, and GPU/EEPROM state is healthy or restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is undefined until variant scope/oracles are approved. Thereafter each variant passes independently only with exact command-target evidence, assigned ACA/counter/deferred/EEPROM results, quiet window and recovery; evidence cannot be pooled across variants.
safety_gate: Execution prohibited until read/write scope and separate oracles are approved.
Dedicated idle GPU SUT with EEPROM baseline and cleanup plan.
One command per independently authorized execution; restore before another.
No automatic retry/reset or unapproved second variant.
expected_evidence: Signed scope decision and variant IDs
Quiet window, cleanup/recovery and final health
test_case.recovery: On unexpected deferred state, EEPROM mutation, storm or hang, preserve evidence and use approved GPU/OOB recovery and EEPROM cleanup; do not run the other variant or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: A singular case contains CRC-read and mode5 CRC-write commands without scope selection, while common criteria do not assign correctable/deferred/EEPROM evidence by variant.

blocked.reason: Engineering can split/approve the variants and their oracles; static coverage remains traceable.
